water_evidence: Blue/cyan J2 and pale/green Cretaceous and Quaternary source geological fields are actual legend classes, not water/background exclusions. No verified separate source-water classifier. Fine hydrography and overprinted mineral symbols remain in Scan, not independently interpreted.

method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
